ui.settings.speech.provider.label.role: Legend of a group of two radio options
ui.settings.speech.provider.label.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.speech.provider.label.length: One short line; English is 15 characters.
ui.settings.speech.provider.label.note: The choice of which service listens and speaks.

ui.settings.speech.provider.description.role: Help line under the group legend
ui.settings.speech.provider.description.note: Says the choice covers hands-free voice and the Speak button on messages, that only the chosen provider is ever used, and that nothing falls back to the other.

ui.settings.speech.provider.radient.labe.tone: Product name plus a noun, sentence case.
ui.settings.speech.provider.radient.labe.length: Two short words; English is 13 characters.
ui.settings.speech.provider.radient.labe.note: Radient is a product name and stays as written; 'cloud' means Radient's hosted service.

ui.settings.speech.provider.radient.desc.note: Speech from this provider is paid for with the person's Radient credit balance. Radient is a product name.

ui.settings.speech.provider.elevenlabs.l.note: The person's own ElevenLabs account key. ElevenLabs is a product name and stays as written.

ui.settings.speech.provider.elevenlabs.d.note: The person uses their own ElevenLabs account and ElevenLabs charges that account. ElevenLabs is a product name.

ui.settings.speech.provider.ready.role: Status line under a radio option
ui.settings.speech.provider.ready.note: This provider can both listen and speak right now.

ui.settings.speech.provider.not_ready.role: Status line under a radio option
ui.settings.speech.provider.not_ready.note: Shown only when the backend sent no sentence of its own for why this provider cannot listen and speak yet.

ui.settings.speech.provider.setup.role: Text button beside a status line
ui.settings.speech.provider.setup.note: Opens the Providers section of Settings, where the key or sign-in for that provider is set up. 'Providers' is that section's name.

ui.settings.speech.provider.none_chosen.note: Neither provider is chosen yet, and hands-free voice cannot start until one is.

ui.settings.speech.provider.save_failed.role: Inline error under the radio options
ui.settings.speech.provider.save_failed.note: Fallback when the daemon refused to store the provider choice and sent no sentence of its own.
